item.text:
The report now documents fifteen reproduced findings at [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_08-26-31-zookeeper-baseline/work/report.md).

This continuation added **F15: `FileTxnLog.append` accepts a duplicate zxid and persists both records**. The method warns when the incoming zxid is not increasing, but still writes the transaction and returns `true`. The repro observed two zxid-1 records in the reopened log:

```
first append: true
WARN ... Current zxid 1 is <= 1 for create
second append: true
logged zxid: 1
logged zxid: 1
txn count: 2
AssertionError: duplicate zxid was retained in the transaction log
```

Reproduction: [DuplicateAppendRepro.java](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_08-26-31-zookeeper-baseline/work/repro/duplicate_append/DuplicateAppendRepro.java).

This complements F14: the follower currently sends redundant proposals to storage, and the storage layer independently accepts and persists duplicate zxids. The other fourteen findings remain documented, including snapshot-fallback state leakage, malformed transaction handling, truncation/recovery issues, epoch initialization failure, and oracle election/revalidation defects. All reproduction files and outputs are under `repro/`; the captured source remains unmodified.
